parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame forms the main structural body of the storage cabinet, made of plywood panels.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and defines the overall shape of the cabinet, holding all other parts together.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that supports the doors, shelves, and base.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom platform of the cabinet, made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the weight of the cabinet and the stored items, ensuring stability on the floor.
parts.Movement_description: It is a stationary part that does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Left)
parts.Basic_description: The left cabinet door is a hinged wooden panel attached to the front of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the interior storage space when opened and conceals contents when closed.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Right)
parts.Basic_description: The right cabinet door is a hinged wooden panel attached to the front of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the right side of the cabinet’s interior and closes to protect stored items.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Shelf (Lower)
parts.Basic_description: The lower shelf is a horizontal plywood panel inside the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a surface for storing items within the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed or occasionally adjustable part that remains stationary during use.

parts.name: Shelf (Upper)
parts.Basic_description: The upper shelf is a horizontal plywood panel positioned above the lower shelf inside the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It provides additional storage space for smaller or lighter items.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed or adjustable but does not move during normal operation.
